text:
Which type of covalent bond is found in both a molecule of methane and a molecule of ethane?
A
a double bond between a carbon atom and a hydrogen atom
B
a double bond between two carbon atoms
C
a single bond between a carbon atom and a hydrogen atom
D
a single bond between two carbon atoms

options.label: A
options.text: a double bond between a carbon atom and a hydrogen atom

options.label: B
options.text: a double bond between two carbon atoms

options.label: C
options.text: a single bond between a carbon atom and a hydrogen atom

options.label: D
options.text: a single bond between two carbon atoms
